options.description: Generate analytics reports for selected product line and report template

transform.output: const reports = output; const selectedReport = reports.find(r => r.id === '{{parameters.report_id}}'); if (!selectedReport || !selectedReport.questions) return []; const questions = selectedReport.questions; let hasDateFields = false; let hasSalesChannelField = false; const isSalesChannelField = (key) => { return questions[key].type === 'salesChannel'; }; const typeMapping = {}; for (const key in questions) { typeMapping[key] = questions[key].type || 'string'; if (questions[key].type === 'salesChannel') { hasSalesChannelField = true; } if (questions[key].type === 'date') { hasDateFields = true; } } const questionFields = Object.keys(questions).filter(key => key !== 'timezone' && questions[key].type !== 'date' && !isSalesChannelField(key)).map(key => { const q = questions[key]; return { name: key, meta: { displayName: `${q.label || key}${q.required ? ' ' : ''}`, displayType: 'text', placeholder: `Enter ${q.label || key} (type: ${q.type || 'string'})`, description: `Type: ${q.type || 'string'}, Required: ${q.required || false}, Default: ${JSON.stringify(q.default || '')}`, validation: { required: q.required || false }, htmlProps: { allowDynamic: true, 'data-type': q.type || 'string' } } }; }); if (hasDateFields) { questionFields.unshift({ name: 'time_gap', meta: { displayName: 'Time Gap ', displayType: 'select', placeholder: 'Select time gap', description: 'Select the time period for date-based filtering in this report', options: [ { label: 'One Day', value: 'ONE_DAY' }, { label: 'One Week', value: 'ONE_WEEK' }, { label: 'One Month', value: 'ONE_MONTH' } ], validation: { required: true, requiredDetail: { errorMsg: 'Time gap is required for reports with date fields' } }, htmlProps: { allowDynamic: false } } }); } if (hasSalesChannelField) { questionFields.unshift({ name: 'sales_channel_id', meta: { config: { url: 'integrations/options', body: { isFp: true, resource: 'reports', operation: 'reports.generate_report', loadOptionsMethod: 'getSalesChannels', secret: '{{parameters.secret}}' }, method: 'post', urlType: 'options', labelKey: 'name', valueKey: '_id' }, options: [], validation: { required: true, requiredDetail: { errorMsg: 'Sales Channel is required' } }, description: 'Select the sales channel for which you want to generate reports.', displayName: 'Sales Channel', displayType: 'autocomplete', placeholder: 'Select a sales channel' } }); } questionFields.push({ name: '__field_types__', meta: { displayType: 'hidden', value: JSON.stringify(typeMapping), htmlProps: { hidden: true } } }); return questionFields;

transform.body: const params = {{parameters}}; const answers = {}; const excludeKeys = ['report_id', 'user_id', 'product_line', 'company_id', 'notification_email_id', 'operation', 'resource', 'secret', 'notification_email_id_hidden', 'time_gap', 'sales_channel_id', '__field_types__']; let typeMapping = {}; try { if (params.__field_types__) { typeMapping = JSON.parse(params.__field_types__); } } catch (e) {} const getType = (key) => { if (typeMapping[key]) return typeMapping[key]; const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase(); if (lowerKey.includes('sales_channel') || lowerKey.includes('saleschannel') || lowerKey.includes('channel_id')) return 'salesChannel'; if (lowerKey.includes('store') || lowerKey.includes('location')) return 'store'; return 'string'; }; for (const key in params) { if (!excludeKeys.includes(key) && params[key] !== undefined && params[key] !== null && params[key] !== '') { const type = getType(key); let value = params[key]; if (type === 'salesChannel') { value = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(v => String(v)) : [String(value)]; } else if (type === 'store') { value = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]; } else { value = String(value); } answers[key] = value; } } answers.notification_email_id = params.notification_email_id || ''; if (params.time_gap) { answers.time_gap = params.time_gap; } return { report_id: params.report_id, user_id: '{{secrets.api_key}}', product_line: params.product_line, company_id: '{{secrets.company_id}}', sales_channel_id: params.sales_channel_id ? [params.sales_channel_id] : [], answers: answers, api_key: '{{secrets.api_key}}', api_secret: '{{secrets.api_secret}}' };
